title: Exact backend field types and declarative constraints
why: Contracts can say int, decimal(p,s), date, datetime, enum and bounded lists, with unique and check constraints enforced by Postgres; money stays exact.

adopt.snippet:
<meta server>
export default {
  name: 'str!',
  sku: { type: 'str!', unique: true },
  price: { type: 'decimal(10,2)', default: '0.00' }
}
